Welcome.

Welcome · QR Remediation
For students rebuilding QR — start where you are

The DAT math isn't math.
It's patterns. We'll find yours.

If you've felt "bad at math" — you're not. Somewhere along the way, a small step got skipped, and everything after it felt harder than it should. We're going to find that step, fix it, and build up from there. No timer. No grade. No catching you off-guard. Each skill teaches you the move, walks you through it, lets you practice, and only marks it "done" when you can do it cold three times in a row. When your brain freezes, hit the red "I need a sec" button — it's there for that exact moment.

START · 01

Diagnostic — find your floor

Up to twenty-two adaptive questions. Not graded. We're mapping where you're solid and where there's a gap. The result is a skill heatmap, your three weakest spots, and a path.

D

Before we start: three things to know

This isn't a test. Read each note before you click begin.
You can't fail this

We're not testing you to grade you — we're trying to find where you got stuck, so we can teach you that exact thing. The more honest you are about what you don't know, the more useful this is.

Take your time

No timer. If you nail a question, the next one gets a little harder. If you miss, the next gets easier. That's how we figure out exactly where you are.

Rate your confidence

After each answer, click how sure you were (1-5 stars). Sometimes you "feel sure and miss" — that's just as useful as getting it right. Be honest, even with yourself.

PERFORMANCE · 04

Pacing ladder

Time pressure unlocks only after untimed mastery. Each tier requires 80% accuracy at the previous tier. We never put a stopwatch in front of you on day one.

Four tiers · climb when ready

No timer until you're ready for one. Then we ratchet down: 90s, 60s, DAT-pace.

When you're ready for the timer · Two-Pass Drill

The pacing simulator that forces you to skip 5 questions in pass 1 — trains the skip move as a first-class skill instead of measuring it after the fact. Gated by 80%+ untimed accuracy at the previous tier.

Why this matters more than a stopwatch. Top-scoring students don't just go faster — they have a different decision pattern. They skip earlier, return more accurately, and never burn 3 minutes on a single question. Watching a clock teaches none of that. The Two-Pass Drill builds the skip-and-return reflex by making it the only way to finish the drill.

What you get: a forced 5-skip first pass, a Skip + Return button with a flagged-queue UI, throttled coach-whisper recommendations ("behind by >30s — skip the next hard one"), and a lift-from-guessing debrief comparing your strategy to all-blank and all-guess baselines.

Open the Two-Pass Drill opens in a new tab · 10 Q drill · 5 forced skips

PERFORMANCE · 05

Test-day simulation

40 questions. DAT pace. No breaks. Per-topic accuracy review at the end. Don't take this until your pacing ladder is at 60s/Q across most patterns — otherwise it'll just rattle you.

Run a full mock

A 40-question set drawn from the full ~960-problem bank, weighted to match the real DAT QR distribution and laddered by difficulty (30/40/20/10 across diff 1-4). 45-minute section timer. Skip-and-return supported. Per-topic accuracy and missed-question walkthrough at the end.
